fact: Car 22 collided with Car 81 in Turn 2.
offence: Alleged breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, telemetry, team radio and in-car video evidence. Both cars had been fighting for position side by side from Turn 1. Car 81 was in front at the apex of Turn 2, then moves slightly to the left on the exit, as Car 22 is moving towards the entry to Turn 3 and a minor collision occurs. The Stewards determine that no driver was wholly or predominantly to blame.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 22 Turn 2 Incident With Car 81
